items.title: Bank of England launches policy statement and draft rules on regulating systemic stablecoins
items.summary: The Bank of England has today published its policy statement and draft Code of Practice (rules) for systemic stablecoin issuers.
items.why: New draft rules and policy statement for regulating systemic stablecoins.

items.title: The Road to Ample - Towards a Demand-driven Liquidity Regime
items.summary: Speech by David Jacobs, Head of Domestic Markets, at the RBA.
items.why: Speech outlines RBA transition to a new demand-driven liquidity operational framework.

items.title: Delay to the November 2026 RTGS standards release
items.why: Unexpected delay to the key RTGS payment system standards release.

items.title: Breaking: Australian economy grows faster than expected, raising rate hike risk
items.summary: Australia's economy grew 0.4 per cent in the June quarter, slightly beating most economist forecasts and further raising the prospect of an interest rate hike as soon as this month.
items.why: GDP beat forecasts, raising prospects for an imminent RBA interest rate hike.
